title: Answer
description:
God swore by Himself after one man’s obedience. That oath stands under both the warning and the comfort.

Two things cannot change: His word and His oath. The heirs of the promise have strong comfort only because both are immutable.

The one who flees for refuge must remain until the pursuer is gone. The hope set before us is that refuge, and the hope itself has already gone in behind the veil.

A forerunner enters ahead of his people and remains. The earlier high priest entered and came out. Jesus has entered as High Priest forever.
